name: Immanence of Set — 1 Basic — Tongue of the Tempter

system.description:
All Setites are chosen for their ability to manipulate the minds of mortal and Cainite alike, but this power heightens those qualities to their utmost, giving the Setite's words a hypnotic sweetness that can loosen the tightest lips and release a victim's innermost desires.

System: The Setite must invoke this power immediately after sundown, spending two Blood Traits and winning a Manipulation + Empathy test against the target's Willpower. That night, the Setite must seek out the victim and engage him in conversation for at least half an hour. If successful, the victim lets slip one of his secret fears or desires without remembering having done so; the number of successes indicates the importance of the secret, at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
